你好，谢谢船长01R对于他们的节点！我正在展示使用他们的一些节点创建的工作流程。

V3b：

你好！我对模型管理系统做了一些改进。不幸的是，我不得不删除三个工作流程并用空白占位符替换它们 - 欢迎您用自己的工作或任何适合您的工作流程来填充它们。

原因：

  • 首先，我没有收到用户的回复，确认我是否可以安全地将他们的工作流程集成到这个公开共享的模板中（具有正确的归属）。

  • 其次，我无法找到几个工作流程的原始创建者。

因此，我做出了一个艰难的决定，只发布最能保持中立和公平的版本，同时仍为您的贡献留出空间。

也就是说，我真诚地感谢所有可能匿名收录作品的创作者——我真的很欣赏你们的创造力和慷慨，即使这次我不能相信你们

我希望它对你有用。我还提供了他们帐户的链接，您可以在其中找到有关他们工作的更多信息。https://civitai.red/models/2492746?modelVersionId=2849381

此工作流程的主要焦点是提高图像质量，并且我添加了一个用于演变提示的系统，可以作为初学者的基础。

我的英语不是很强，所以有时某些提示可能不完全符合我的意图。

请随时纠正和完善它们——感谢您的理解！

此致

注意：请记住指定提示文件的保存文件夹。

o.en:
Hello and thank you toCapitan01Rfor their Nodes! I'm presenting a workflow created using some of their Nodes.

V3b:

Hello! I’ve made a few improvements to the model management system. Unfortunately, I had to remove three workflows and replace them with blank placeholders — which you’re welcome to fill with your own work or any workflow that serves you well.

The reason:

  • First, I didn’t receive responses from users confirming whether I could safely integrate their workflows into this publicly shared template (with proper attribution).

  • Second, I wasn’t able to locate the original creators of severals workflows.

As a result, I made the difficult decision to publish only the version that best preserves neutrality and fairness — while still leaving space for your contributions.

That said, I sincerely thank all the creators whose work may have been included anonymously—I truly appreciate your creativity and generosity, even if I couldn’t credit you this time around

I hope it will be useful to you. I've also included a link to their account where you can find more information about their work.https://civitai.red/models/2492746?modelVersionId=2849381

The main focus of this workflow is to enhance image quality, and I've added a system for evolving prompts that can serve as a foundation for beginners.

I’m not very strong in English, so there may be times when some prompts don’t do exactly what I intend.

Please feel free to correct and refine them — and thank you for your understanding!

Best regards

A note: remember to specify the save folder for your prompt files.
